title: remove_transition ignores State/Enum members inside a list for source/dest
property: removing with source=[State] (or dest=[State]) removes exactly the same transitions as passing the state name strings
input: Machine(states=['A','B','C'], auto_transitions=False); add_transition('go','A','B'); add_transition('go','B','C'); remove_transition('go', source=[m.get_state('A')])
actual: nothing is removed; both transitions remain
evidence: Docstring: source/dest are 'str, Enum or State'; the code listify()s the argument and converts each element, but the comprehension tests hasattr(source, 'name') (the whole list/original arg) instead of hasattr(s, 'name'), so list elements that are State/Enum are never converted to names and never match t.source/t.dest (stored as names). The same State passed alone (not in a list) works.
